name: Daniil
description: Daniil Nahliuk — Computer Engineering student at the University of Washington. Projects in embedded systems, firmware, and machine learning.
biography: I'm Daniil, a Computer Engineering student at the University of Washington. I'm based in Tacoma, WA. At Idaho National Laboratory, I worked on secure boot and multicore firmware. I also researched federated intrusion detection at UW's SESAIS Lab.
introduction: I work mostly with embedded systems, C/C++, and machine learning. Here are some of my projects and the work I've done.
aboutNote: Outside of engineering, I'm interested in history, philosophy, music, and learning about different places.
